nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; stores token balances of every holder
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; stores approvals
uint256 private _tTotal = 100*10**12*10**18; fixed total supply
string private _name = ' Ghost In The Shell Token  '
string private _symbol = 'GHOSTSHELL'
uint8 private _decimals = 18
address private _owner; privileged address inherited from Ownable
address private newComer = _msgSender(); deployment-time snapshot used by the onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner
ghostshell constructor: assigns _tTotal to _balances[_msgSender()] and emits Transfer; Ownable constructor sets _owner
modifier onlyOwner: require(newComer == _msgSender()); non-standard ownership gate
owner() public view returns _owner
renounceOwnership(): sets _owner to address(0), guarded by onlyOwner
transferOwnership(address newOwner) private onlyOwner: writes _owner, but private visibility makes it unreachable
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender
_approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount): writes _allowances, but zeroes the allowance and emits Approval(...,4) whenever ol != owner()
allowance(address owner, address spender): reads _allowances
approve(address spender, uint256 amount): calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): calls _transfer then re-approves with SafeMath.sub of the allowance
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount): calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): SafeMath sub/add on _balances and Transfer event
balanceOf(address account): reads _balances
totalSupply(): returns _tTotal
name(): returns _name
symbol(): returns _symbol
decimals(): returns _decimals
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for minting, approvals, transfers and the newComer ownership snapshot
_approve silently forces _allowances[ol][tt] = 0 and emits Approval(ol, tt, 4) for every approver that is not owner(), breaking standard ERC20 approval semantics
onlyOwner validates the caller against the immutable newComer snapshot taken at deployment instead of the current _owner, so the ownership check and renounceOwnership/transferOwnership diverge
transferOwnership is declared private and is never called internally, so ownership can never be transferred to a new address

local address msgSender = _msgSender(); in the Ownable constructor, assigned to _owner

edges.reason: constructor credits _balances[_msgSender()] with _tTotal, minting the whole supply to the deployer
constructor calls _msgSender() to obtain the initial owner/mint target
Ownable constructor stores the result of _msgSender() into the local msgSender
local msgSender is written into the _owner state variable at deployment
_msgSender() simply returns the untrusted msg.sender value
msg.sender determines who receives the minted total supply in the constructor
msg.sender becomes the ol (allowance owner) argument of _approve through approve() and transferFrom()
in transfer() msg.sender is passed as the sender argument of _transfer, allowing movement of any balance from the caller
newComer is initialised from _msgSender() at deployment and is the only address accepted by onlyOwner
any caller that is not owner() hits the branch that wipes _allowances[ol][tt] to zero inside _approve
the immutable newComer snapshot is the sole value used by the non-standard ownership gate
the unsafe newComer comparison implements the onlyOwner modifier body
onlyOwner reads the newComer state variable to authorise the caller
onlyOwner compares the caller obtained via _msgSender() against newComer
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership
owner() returns the _owner state variable
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0) if the untrusted gate passes
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner
transferOwnership is private and has no internal caller, making the ownership write dead code
approve() delegates all work to _approve
approve() passes _msgSender() as the approver
transferFrom() moves the tokens by calling _transfer
transferFrom() calls _approve to update the remaining allowance
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender when consuming the allowance
transfer() calls _transfer with the caller as sender
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the sending account
_approve branches on ol != owner(), making owner() decide whether the allowance is truncated
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
the allowance-wiping unsafe operation is reached inside the _approve non-owner branch
the unsafe operation zeroes _allowances[ol][tt] and emits a bogus Approval value
allowance() reads the _allowances mapping
_transfer reads and writes _balances for both sender and recipient
balanceOf() reads the _balances mapping
totalSupply() returns _tTotal
name() returns _name
symbol() returns _symbol
decimals() returns _decimals
caller-supplied spender is forwarded by approve() to _approve
caller-supplied amount is forwarded by approve() to _approve
_approve consumes the ol parameter as allowance owner
_approve consumes the tt parameter as allowance spender and as the key that gets zeroed
_approve consumes the amount parameter when writing the allowance
transferFrom forwards the sender parameter to _transfer
transferFrom forwards the recipient parameter to _transfer
transferFrom forwards the amount parameter to _transfer and to SafeMath.sub
allowance() uses the owner parameter as the mapping key
allowance() uses the spender parameter as the nested mapping key
transfer forwards the recipient parameter to _transfer
transfer forwards the amount parameter to _transfer
_transfer uses the sender parameter as the debited balance key
_transfer uses the recipient parameter as the credited balance key
_transfer uses the amount parameter for the SafeMath sub/add operations
transferOwnership assigns the newOwner parameter to _owner
balanceOf() uses the account parameter as the _balances key
the tt parameter of _approve is the spender slot that the unsafe operation resets to zero

normalization_plan.reason: spender only exists to be forwarded from approve() into _approve, so it can be collapsed into the approve function node
amount only exists to be forwarded from approve() into _approve, so it can be collapsed into the approve function node
ol is the local name of the approval owner inside _approve and carries no independent semantics
tt is the local name of the approval spender inside _approve; it is also the key wiped by the unsafe allowance reset
amount belongs exclusively to the _approve allowance write
sender is only used to forward into _transfer inside transferFrom
recipient is only used to forward into _transfer inside transferFrom
amount is only used for _transfer and the SafeMath.sub allowance update inside transferFrom
the owner parameter is a pure view-lookup key for _allowances inside allowance()
the spender parameter is a pure view-lookup key for _allowances inside allowance()
recipient is only forwarded from transfer() into _transfer
amount is only forwarded from transfer() into _transfer
sender is the balance key debited by _transfer
recipient is the balance key credited by _transfer
amount is the value used in the SafeMath sub/add and the Transfer event of _transfer
newOwner is the only argument that is written into _owner inside the unreachable private function
account is a pure view-lookup key for _balances inside balanceOf()
the local msgSender exists only inside the constructor to be copied into _owner, so it merges into the constructor node
